description: Check push settings before importing devices: warns when APNs or Firebase is not set up, or APNs is on sandbox. Imported tokens only work with the same bundle ID, Apple team and Firebase project the app used with the previous provider. Show these warnings to the user before starting an import.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

platforms.description: Platforms to import (default both). Web push cannot be imported: browsers tie those subscriptions to the previous provider's VAPID keys.

name: get_push_import_preflight

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_push_import_preflight` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Push settings checks: { code, severity (warning|info), message }.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
